{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件","id":"gh:1405520053","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-notify-sounds","slug":"BillCx330/dsh-plugin-notify-sounds","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-notify-sounds"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A soft chime when the agent is waiting for you — or when it is done.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Walk away from the window without missing anything: an OS notification whether the window is minimis"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ed, covered, or merely unfocused (**click it to jump back**), and a "Waiting for you" / "Finished" m"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ark on the taskbar title. Once you have seen it, the plugin goes quiet — it will not nag you like an"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"skbar title. Once you have seen it, the plugin goes quiet — it will not nag you like an alarm clock."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Install**: DSH → **Plugins** in the left sidebar → Add plugin, paste the line below (keep the vers"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ion — a release younger than 24 hours is resolved back to the previous one by pnpm's `minimumRelease"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"Age`) and press **Install**:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 🎨 Consistent with DSH's design language"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Every visual detail of the settings section comes from DSH's own design system: row geometry, divide"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rs, type sizes and spacing use the official design tokens, the sound picker is the official `Menu` p"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"rimitive, the icons come from the official family, and the layout follows the native text-left, cont"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"rol-right row shape. Installing it does not introduce a visually disjoint third-party block into you"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ow shape. Installing it does not introduce a visually disjoint third-party block into your settings."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## ✨ What it can do"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| What | What you get |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **Your decision is needed** | A chime when the agent raises an approval, a plan review, or a quest"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ion — separate sounds for approvals and questions |
| **Task finished** | A chime when a session goe"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"s from running to idle |
| **Aware even when you are away** | An OS notification whenever the window"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" is minimised, covered, or merely unfocused (body is the approval reason or the question itself; **c"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"lick to return to the window**) plus a taskbar title mark |
| **Missed it? It reminds again** | Unan"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"swered decisions re-ping every 1/5/15/30 minutes — and **stop for good once you have seen them**, ev"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"en if you switch away again |
| **Only what you care about** | Sub-agents (background tasks) are com"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"pletely silent by default — only your own conversation is announced |
| **Quiet when it should be** "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"| Quiet hours (e.g. 22:00–08:00, wrapping past midnight), notify-only-when-hidden, and a master swit"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"ch |
| **Your sound, your way** | Nine built-in sounds, levelled to each other; **up to three of you"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"r own clips**, named and assignable to any alert (mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a, up to 15s each); volume — e"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"ach feature with its own toggle |
| **Update checks** | Checks npm for a newer version and points at"},{"id":"p12s13","text":" the route that installs it — the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar (uninstall, then add again), the "},{"id":"p12s14","text":"marketplace, or `dsh plugin add` on a web profile; the row also flags an install the profile's lockf"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"ile does not match |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 💡 Why"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"DSH tells you things visually — status dots, sidebar marks. The moment you switch to another window,"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" you can neither see nor hear anything, while the agent may be stuck waiting for one sentence from y"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"u can neither see nor hear anything, while the agent may be stuck waiting for one sentence from you."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This plugin turns "it is waiting for you" and "it is done" into sound. With system notifications and"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" the title mark you know what happened even while away; and once you come back and see it, it goes q"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"uiet — the repeat reminder only chases decisions you have **never** seen."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 🔔 Sounds"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Bell · Chime · Ding · Drop · Pulse · Arc · Coin · Success · Knock — nine built-in sounds, all synthe"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"sized live with Web Audio: no audio files, no network requests."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Or upload your own audio (mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a, up to 15s and 3MB each, validated and loudness-norm"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"alized), or pick "None" for notifications only. Each trigger (approval / question / completion) gets"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" its own sound, with preview right in the settings."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## ⚙️ Settings"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Settings → **Sounds** (between General and Models). Every feature has its own toggle, styled exactly"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" like DSH's own preference pages:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"master switch and volume · per-trigger sounds with preview · sub-agent alerts · system notifications"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" · window title alert · repeat interval · quiet hours · hidden-only mode · up to three named clips o"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"f your own · update checks (installs go through the package manager)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Everything applies immediately — no restart needed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## ⚠️ Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Where custom audio lives**: each file is stored by content hash under `profiles/<profile>/notify"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"-sounds/sounds/<sha256>.<ext>`, and the config keeps only its name. **Back up (or move) the whole pr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ofile directory** — copying `cordis.patch.yml` alone does not carry the audio. After uninstalling, a"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"t most the last file stays behind (a few hundred KB).
- **Hand-edited config**: preferences live in "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; values must match the schema (volume 0–100, a preset id, `HH:MM` t"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"imes) or the plugin declines to load — just fix the value. The settings UI only ever writes valid va"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"lues.
- **Upgrades are installed by the package manager, not by the plugin**: 1.8.0 removed the self"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"-installer (writing files in place never updated the profile's lockfile, so the next plugin install "},{"id":"p24s9","text":"silently restored the old version). The update row still checks npm and reports a newer version, the"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"n points at the route that installs — the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar (uninstall, then add agai"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"n), the marketplace, or `dsh plugin add` on a web profile.
- **Versions up to 1.7.0** reach 1.8.0 th"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"rough their own updater (1.8.0 keeps the same seven filenames), but that arrival is not registered w"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"ith pnpm: reinstall once through the package manager as above and every later upgrade stays in place"},{"id":"p24s14","text":". Versions up to 1.6.9 cannot install a release that adds a file — their fixed whitelist refuses it "},{"id":"p24s15","text":"safely; the same one-time reinstall fixes that too.
- **Multiple windows** elect one page to speak ("},{"id":"p24s16","text":"since 1.7.0): sounds, system notifications and repeat reminders therefore fire once for the whole GU"},{"id":"p24s17","text":"I, not once per window. Title marks stay per-window, because each window has its own title. If the s"},{"id":"p24s18","text":"peaking page closes or crashes, another takes over within seconds.
- **Click-to-return** is fully im"},{"id":"p24s19","text":"plemented and tested on Windows; macOS / Linux fall back to the system deep link and are unverified."},{"id":"p24s20","text":" and tested on Windows; macOS / Linux fall back to the system deep link and are unverified.
